title: 2 BOXES OF RETRO BARBIE JEEP, ...
reason: Vintage 1980s style Barbie jeep with matching horse trailer, plus pre-decimal Wife and Home magazines and costume dolls; the title undersells the set, but completeness and maker marks are unproven.
findings: One photo, enlarged on the magazines, dolls, trailer, jar, tin and jeep. Cream and orange plastic Barbie 4x4 jeep with brown roll bars and a rear winch, plus a matching brown horse trailer carrying a Barbie logo decal (desert sunset badge with pink and purple stripes), 1980s style. No Mattel or date mark is visible, so the make is inferred from the Barbie decals only. Also in the lot: two small costume dolls (dark hair, folk-style dress), two Wife and Home magazines (Holiday Knitting Number, price 6d so pre-decimal, month August, year not legible), a studio pottery jar labelled COFFEE with a cork lid, a blue pressed tin with a floral panel, and a heap of white embroidered linen (the night shirts). The title mentions the jeep but not the horse trailer, dolls or magazines. No windscreen, horse, doll figures or accessories are visible with the set.
condition: Jeep and trailer look complete in shape but grubby, with some yellowing to the cream plastic and no windscreen seen. Trailer sides appear intact. Condition of the tin, dolls and linen cannot be judged from one photo.
rescore_note: Mixed lot led by a 1980s style Barbie 4x4 jeep and horse trailer (Barbie decals only, no maker mark seen), grubby and incomplete with no windscreen, horse or figures; pre-decimal Wife and Home magazines, souvenir dolls, pottery jar, tin and linen add a little. Whole lot realistically in the upper $30-80 band, a bit more if split up. (No fresh comps, search limit hit.)
